description: Requires signing in to Plain; calling it prompts sign-in when needed. Lists companies explicitly approved for this Plain connection that you still have access to, and marks the active company. Reports granted scopes and whether the connection can create unsigned offers. Check this before quoting for an existing company or offering to create offers. Reconnect requesting onboarding:write to approve offer creation, or reconnect to approve additional companies. Company permissions are checked separately when creating offers.
name: list_companies
title: List permitted companies
